categories.name: Trademark lawyers (forced rebrands & domain changes)
categories.opportunity: When a trademark dispute or clearance problem forces a business to rename, it must move its website to a new domain. Done poorly, that can cost much of its search visibility.
categories.rationale: This is an urgent, budgeted moment where SEO migration expertise is valuable and the lawyer is the first adviser involved.

triggers.event: A client receives a cease-and-desist or fails trademark clearance
triggers.whyNeed: A rebrand and domain migration are needed
triggers.referralMoment: When the rebrand decision is made
triggers.partnerValue: Their client's business survives the rename intact

categories.mutualValue: Lawyers give clients a practical next step; you get urgent, well-funded migration projects. You can refer clients needing trademark clearance before a launch.
categories.approach: Publish a rebrand-migration checklist and share it with IP lawyers. Offer a free migration-risk review for their clients.

guardrails.title: Links are a by-product of genuine collaboration
guardrails.body: Shared-audience partnerships can produce earned, editorial links, but exchanging links for payment or as a condition of partnership violates search engine spam policies. Focus on resources and content that are useful to both audiences.

guardrails.title: Partnerships are not paid-referral arrangements
guardrails.body: This analysis recommends building relationships based on mutual value. It does not assume that referral fees, commissions, exclusivity, or endorsements are permitted in your industry. Check professional, regulatory, and contractual rules before compensating anyone for referrals.

guardrails.title: Outreach in Canada: CASL applies
guardrails.body: Commercial electronic messages generally need express or implied consent, sender identification, and a working unsubscribe mechanism. Implied consent can exist when a business email address is conspicuously published, the message relates to the recipient's role, and they have not said they don't want such messages. Keep records of how consent was obtained. Personal information you collect is also subject to privacy law (e.g. PIPEDA).

guardrails.title: No automated outreach
guardrails.body: This tool does not contact anyone on your behalf. Every introduction should be personal, relevant to the recipient, and easy to decline.
